title: Course
description: A Blocks course document: the course content and nothing else (ADR-0002).

kind.description: A full course, or a microlearning course shown one step at a time.

authors.description: Authors shown to learners (the author byline).

themeRef.description: Reserved: the theme or brand kit, owned by another container.

languages.description: Reserved: languages the course is translated into.

glossaryRef.description: Reserved: translation glossary, owned by another container.

navigation.description: How learners move through the course. Every setting is optional; the default is given with each.

restricted.description: Lessons open only in order, each once the one before it is done; turns off learner mark-done. Default false; any quiz with skip-ahead turns it on.

learnerMarkDone.description: While navigation is free, learners may mark an unfinished lesson (not a quiz) done. Default false.

off.description: No course menu and no search: learners start from the cover and go on lesson by lesson. Default false.

menu.description: The course menu: a sidebar, a compact card at the bottom left, or an overlay card at the top. Default sidebar.

menuClosed.description: The sidebar starts closed on wide screens too. Default false.

sectionsClosed.description: Section groups of the sidebar and the compact menu start collapsed. Default false.

menuStyle.description: The look of the menu and the compact card: light, gray, the theme colour, its tint, dark, a dark shade of the theme colour, or the cover picture under a light or dark overlay. Its text keeps 4.5:1. Default light.

progressIndicator.description: The status mark beside each lesson in the menu: the theme's (its status in words), a circle that fills with its progress, or a done or not-done mark. Default theme.

compactCount.description: The compact menu's card shows which lesson is open, as its number of the total. Default true.

search.description: Course search in the sidebar; there is none with another menu, with navigation off or restricted. Default true.

pageButtons.description: Previous and next lesson buttons: full-width at the top and bottom of each lesson, floating at the bottom of the screen, a floating bar across the bottom of the screen, or none (branching courses). Default full-width.

pageButtonColor.description: Colour of the previous and next lesson buttons: white, dark, the theme colour or its tint. Default white.

steps.description: Microlearning: one step at a time instead of one continuous page. Default false.

stepIndicator.description: Stepped microlearning: the step indicator as a plain bar, numbered, or none. Default bar.

videoSpeed.description: Learners may play videos from 0.25 to 2 times their speed. Default true.

media.description: Media index: every media file the document references, by storage key.

SchemaVersion.description: MAJOR.MINOR. MINOR adds optional fields only; MAJOR is any other change.

ProjectId.description: Project id: a random version 4 UUID.

Id.description: Content id, unique within the document: a lowercase letter and 9 lowercase letters or digits.

EntryRef.description: Id of a lesson or quiz entry in this document.

QuizRef.description: Id of a quiz entry in this document.

CategoryRef.description: Id of a category item in the same block.

CustomBlockRef.description: Id of a custom-block document in this document.

ExternalId.description: Content id of an object in another container.

ExternalRef.description: Reference to an object owned by another container (library, question bank, template); never reported as missing.

Ext.description: Extension data, keyed by reverse-DNS namespace; each value is any JSON and is kept verbatim.

Timestamp.description: RFC 3339 date and time in UTC.

RelativeUrl.description: An address relative to the course's page: no scheme, not starting with // or a query or fragment, no spaces or backslashes.

StorageKey.description: Key of a media file in the project container.

VariantKey.description: Key of an optimised variant of a media file in the project container.

MediaKeyRef.description: Storage key of an entry in the media index.

MediaEntry.description: One media file in the media index; the bytes live in the project container.

aiPrompt.description: Reserved (AI provenance): the prompt that generated this file.

licence.description: Reserved: licence of the file, an SPDX id where one exists.

attribution.description: Reserved: attribution text the licence requires.

MediaRef.description: Use of a media file from the media index.

alt.description: Alternative text; empty marks the image as decorative.

captions.description: Caption tracks of a video, one WebVTT file per language.

CaptionTrack.description: A WebVTT caption file of a video, in one language.

LabelSetRef.description: Learner-facing strings: the built-in set for a language, or a set owned by another container.

statusWording.description: Status the LMS records when the course is done, and while it is not.

passingScore.description: Score in percent at or above which the learner passes.

tracking.description: What decides completion: the completion rule, or the result of one quiz.

manifestIdentifier.description: Base identifier of the SCORM manifest.

moveOn.description: cmi5: what the LMS waits for before it counts the course as done. Default Passed when a quiz decides the result, otherwise Completed.

exitLink.description: Show an exit-course link in the course menu. Default false.

LomMetadata.description: Learning Object Metadata written into the package manifest.

Entry.description: One entry of the course outline.

SectionEntry.description: Section header: groups the lessons below it and holds no blocks.

author.description: Author shown on this lesson instead of the course authors.

authorHidden.description: No author on this lesson's header. Default false.

questions.description: Questions in order, and draws from question banks.

QuizSettings.description: How a quiz is taken and passed. Every setting is optional; the default is given with each.

passingScore.description: Score in percent at or above which the learner passes. Default 80.

retries.description: Attempts allowed after the first one. Default: unlimited.

requirePassing.description: A learner who fails must retry before going on; with no retries left the course cannot be completed. Default false.

skipAhead.description: A learner who passes may jump to a later entry; skipped entries count as complete. Default: off.

learnerChooses.description: Let the learner choose whether to skip. Default false.

buttonLabel.description: The skip button's text when the learner chooses; unset, the label set's.

shuffleQuestions.description: Ask the questions in a new random order on each attempt. Default false.

shuffleAnswers.description: Show answer choices in a new random order on each attempt. Default false.

revealAnswers.description: What the results show: every answer with its feedback, nothing, or only the learner's wrong answers. Default all.

timer.description: Time limit for each attempt. At zero the attempt is submitted and unanswered questions are wrong. Default: no timer.

display.description: Time shown to the learner. Default remaining.

countAsLesson.description: Include the quiz in the lesson count. Default true.

finishButton.description: How the button after the results looks. Default next-lesson.

QuizQuestion.description: One question of a quiz, or a draw of several from a question bank.

QuestionDraw.description: Random questions from a question bank. The pool is a copy of the bank's questions taken when the author adds or updates the draw; later bank edits reach it only then.

count.description: Questions drawn per attempt. Default: all of them, in random order. A knowledge check always shows one.

exclude.description: Bank questions the author left out of the pool.

PoolQuestion.description: A copy of a bank question. The copy has its own ids in this document, so several draws can copy the same bank question.

bankQuestion.description: Id of the question in the bank, as used by exclude.

Block.description: Block envelope. The shape of variantSettings and items per variant is defined with each block.

draw.description: Knowledge check: one random question from a question bank.

link.description: Link to a shared block template or question-bank question.

VariantSettings.description: Settings of one block variant, keyed by camelCase name; each block's own schema narrows them.

connectToNext.description: Show this block and the next one in the same step (microlearning).

oneOf.description: A light tint of the course's theme colour (Theme).

Narration.description: Audio narration of a block (AI provenance is on the media entry).

position.description: Where the narration player sits in the block. Default bottom.

ItemEmbed.description: A web embed of an interactive block's item: a player of a listed provider, loaded only when the learner asks for it.

url.description: What the author pasted, to edit it again.

provider.description: The listed provider named on the button that loads it; embedUrl is one of its players.

ContentItem.description: Title, text and optional media: accordion and tab panels, timeline events, list entries, gallery images.

MarkerItem.description: Marker on an image, placed by percentage of the image size.

StepItem.description: Process card: an introduction, a numbered step or a summary.

imageStyle.description: The side's picture centred above its text with a frame, or filling the side. Default centred.

title.description: Heading shown with the button and its description.

oneOf.description: A page or file next to the published course, by its address relative to the course's page; it opens in a new tab.
A new message in the learner's mail app to these addresses, with the course title as its subject.
Ends the course; shown in learning-system packages only.

SortingItem.description: Sorting-activity card and the category it belongs in.

feedback.description: The one message for any response (feedbackMode any).

media.description: A picture, audio or video under the prompt.

audio.description: Audio played with the prompt, beside a picture or video in media (blocks-interactions.md 2.12).

feedback.description: The one message for any response (feedbackMode any).

media.description: A picture, audio or video under the prompt.

audio.description: Audio played with the prompt, beside a picture or video in media (blocks-interactions.md 2.12).

caseSensitive.description: A typed answer must match an accepted answer's capitals too. Default false.

feedback.description: The one message for any response (feedbackMode any).

media.description: A picture, audio or video under the prompt.

audio.description: Audio played with the prompt, beside a picture or video in media (blocks-interactions.md 2.12).

freezeColumn.description: The column learners see in the authored order; the other is shuffled. Default: both shuffled (blocks-interactions.md 2.12).

feedback.description: The one message for any response (feedbackMode any).

media.description: A picture, audio or video under the prompt.

audio.description: Audio played with the prompt, beside a picture or video in media (blocks-interactions.md 2.12).

FeedbackMode.description: Feedback by correct or incorrect, per answer choice (single choice), or one message for any response. Default correctness.

CustomBlockDocument.description: Placeholder for a free-form custom-block document; its object tree is defined with custom blocks.

Theme.description: The course's look (rise.md 3E, blocks-editor.md 2.18): one for every language of the course. Every setting is optional; the default is given with each.

layout.description: Layout style: a preset of cover and lesson header layouts. Default classic.
Image on the left or right of the title, the image behind it, or no image. Default split-left.

overlay.description: Over a cover image behind the title. Default dark at 50 %.

startButton.description: The start or resume button; without it learners start from the outline. Default true.

author.description: Authors on the cover. Default true.

skip.description: Published courses open at the first lesson, or where the learner stopped, instead of the cover. Default false.

crop.description: The part of the course's cover image shown; another image than the one it was made for shows whole.

logoSize.description: The logo's height: small 1x, medium 1.5x, large 2x. Default small.

logoSquare.description: The logo in a square, cut to fit from its middle. Default false.

hidden.description: Hides the lesson count, title and author; the title stays for screen readers. Default false.

image.description: Behind the title in the image layout; a lesson's own header image comes first.

overlay.description: Over the image of the image layout. Default dark at 60 %.

contrast.description: Text on the color layout. Default auto.

lessonCount.description: The lesson n of m label. Default true.

author.description: The lesson's author, or the course's. Default true.

color.description: Theme colour, for everything set to theme or theme tint, links, buttons and marks. Default #ff631e.

contrast.description: Text on the theme colour: auto keeps 4.5:1 (rise.md rule 18), light and dark are fixed. Default auto.

fonts.description: A role without a font shows in the learner's device fonts, so the package carries no font for it; the interface font follows the heading font.

animations.description: Blocks whose entrance animation is on fade in as they scroll into view. Default true.

textSizes.description: Default text sizes in CSS pixels, which follow the learner's own text size setting.

ThemeImage.description: An image of the theme from the media index, with its crop.

alt.description: Alternative text; empty marks the image as decorative.

Crop.description: The part of an image shown: a rectangle in percent of the image's width and height, from its top left corner.

key.description: The image it was made for, where the image is set apart from the crop.

FontRef.description: A bundled open-licence font, or a font of the author's own font library (another container), resolved by its id when the course is shown or published; a font the library no longer has shows as the default font.

name.description: Its name when it was chosen.
